Third occurrence of the signature, now AT CAP per the specled_-csg orchestration policy (comments on specled_-csg: FLAKE ACCEPTED #1 after .1, #2 after .3; policy said 3rd occurrence requires an investigation ticket).

Occurrences:
1. 2026-07-17 specled_-csg.1 merge gate (local) — standalone re-run green
2. 2026-07-17 specled_-csg.3 merge gate (local) — standalone re-run green
3. 2026-07-22 GitHub Actions run 29944042016 on feat/specled_-csg-evidence-ledger-split (bc6837b) — failing test tracer_test.exs:241 under the merged tagged_tests invocation (70+ files)

Signature: only fires in the big merged tagged_tests run, never standalone or in plain 'mix test'. Never intersects the diffs it fails on. Likely suspects: compiler-tracer manifest state shared across the merged run, test-order dependence, or CI-runner timing. Related: specled_-f98 (flaky one-off failures in full-suite runs, 2026-07-02).

comments.text: Recurring observation (epic specled_-155 pipeline, 2026-07-23): the command-runner temp-script race now seen 3x — (1) merge gate 1 mix test stray 'specled_cmd_*.sh: No such file or directory'; (2) T3 verify mix test --stale same; (3) T7 verify spec.check run1 exit 127 'exs: command not found' on UNTOUCHED evidence_store target.sh, passing manually and on runs 2-3. Class: tempfile_command_execution race. All runs otherwise green; no flake-accepts consumed.

4th observation (2026-07-23, epic specled_-155 merge gate 9, epic @ af16144): 1/1136 failure in full-suite run, did not reproduce on immediate full re-run (0 failures), --failed manifest empty, docs-only delta since prior green gate. Flake-accepted once at the gate per protocol. Exact test identity lost to output piping — orchestrator process fixed to capture full gate output going forward.

Board triage 2026-07-24 (verified against HEAD a509836): (1) The tempfile_command_execution race noted in comments here is now its own bug: specled_-vnw — it is unrelated to the tracer property flake. (2) specled_-qvg merged into this ticket and closed: its analysis found merge_edges/3 pure (tracer.ex:294-311), all four property invariants hold by construction, no derivable counterexample; leading hypothesis is a suite-capacity timeout artifact, not a real bug. (3) Occurrence 3 datum is permanently lost — CI run 29944042016 has 0 artifacts and no ExUnit seed/counterexample in logs. Remaining actionable work: adopt qvg capture-on-recurrence protocol (on next flake: record failure mode — timeout vs counterexample — plus seed, one-command repro), and add a seed-echo/capture step to specs.yml so the next occurrence is diagnosable. NOTE: flake is at accept-cap per specled_-csg policy — next occurrence hard-blocks a merge gate.

CAPTURE-ON-RECURRENCE PROTOCOL (adopted per 2026-07-24 triage; qvg analysis)

On the next occurrence of the tracer_test.exs:241 flake (which hard-blocks the merge gate — accept-cap reached):

1. Record the failure mode: verification_command_timeout (supports qvg's suite-capacity-timeout hypothesis) vs verification_command_failed with a StreamData counterexample (would falsify it).
2. Record the ExUnit seed: findings for merged tagged_tests failures/timeouts now echo "exunit seed: N" with a --seed repro hint (both attributed and shared-fate paths).
3. Record the one-command repro: the finding's command line + " --seed N".
4. In CI: download the specled-command-output artifact (uploaded on failure by the Check specs job; SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR) — it holds the full run output including the counterexample. Locally: set SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR before the gate command to get the same capture.
5. Post all of the above here, then attempt the seeded repro standalone and under the merged invocation.

Only after a diagnosable occurrence is captured does root-cause work proceed; do not consume further flake-accepts on this signature.
